stories.title: NFL considering change to Internation games travel
stories.summary:
Making teams arrive a certain number of days before, instead of the current policy of letting the team decide when to get there...



	 



	NFL exploring possibility of implementing new travel rules for international games



	 



	
		Quote
	

	
		
			With the NFL's uptick in international games over the last few years, there's no rule requiring a team to arrive in a foreign city by a certain date before a game, but that could change. That could change soon. The NFL is currently exploring a new travel policy that would require each team to spend a minimum number of nights in an international city. In an interview this week with The Athletic, NFL executive VP of club business Peter O'Reilly confirmed that a change could be coming.

I am trying to understand the pass defense woes in terms of total passing yards given.



	 



	The Bills are ranked 28th after the Jets game at around 240 yards per game.  The defense gave up 285 yards in passing against the Jets. 



	 



	I did a little analysis on gemini to see how the CB/S/LBs stack up base on the average yards/game given by each players.   Here is the sorted list.



	 



	Surprisingly, it is Benford that is leaking almost 38 yards per game -  at the same level as Gardner Johnson. 



	
	Hairston had a rough outing against the Patriots...



	 



	How do we get better play from Benford, Bishop and Bernard?
